title: Asymptotics of Laplace and Stokes solutions in the gap between a sharp tip and a smooth boundary
summary: We derive an explicit description of the asymptotic singular behavior of 2D Laplace and Stokes solutions as the distance between a Lipschitz sharp tip and a smooth boundary vanishes. While classical lubrication theory for smoother boundaries relies on the anisotropy of the gap to perform dimensional reduction, the isotropic scaling imposed by a corner singularity requires a different approach.
